rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a high-quality blastocyst, but it undercalls the reported hatching status by describing the zona as intact without a large obvious gap and relies partly on the provided grade rather than clearly image-grounded features.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, endometriosis, smoking, semen parameters, endometrial thickness, and first-cycle status with embryo quality and prognosis.
Reasoning is logical and well structured, with conclusions mostly supported by the data; only minor issues such as some speculative comments about transfer strategy and morphology uncertainty.

Recommendations are largely consistent with IVF best practices, including elective single embryo transfer and caution about add-ons; minor deviations include somewhat speculative discussion of freeze-all/endometriosis strategies without case-specific indications.

Provides clear, practical next steps for the current transfer and sensible contingency planning for future cycles, with appropriate nuance about smoking cessation, SET, luteal support, and when to escalate evaluation.
